segments.comment: A debug Knight rides his saddled pony (#ride, forcing the mount), level-teleports to D:4 mounted, and dies to a wished wand of death zapped at himself, saving bones. bones.c savebones() calls steed.c dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_BONES), which puts the pony on the hero's square and then moves it to an adjacent one with enexto() and rloc_to(), making room for the ghost.
